lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like formation across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, forming distinct anchor nodes within the lateral pattern grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the superior edge and lower intensity below.
